   "Physical ETFs remain superior for markets where tax regimes allow for efficient dividend pass-through, such as specific European jurisdictions, or where capital gains taxes are embedded in redemption fees rather than swap pricing.",
   "Daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs creates pro-cyclical, negative gamma flows that can amplify market volatility, with significant liquidity impacts observed in concentrated markets like Korea.",
   "The US ETF market maintains a first-mover advantage over Europe due to the 1940 Act regulatory framework, tax efficiencies, and a more industrialized model portfolio distribution system."
  ],
  "risks": [

  "type": "macro",
  "priority": "medium",
  "published": "2026-09-28",
  "insights": [
   "Financial markets and the economy have historically relied on an implicit safety net consisting of a monetary put from central banks and a fiscal put from governments to smooth the business cycle.",
   "These policy stabilisers, which reached their peak during the Covid-19 pandemic, are now constrained by high sovereign yields, record debt-to-GDP ratios, and persistent supply-driven inflation.",
